A stable latency that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot unwind. Keep the explicit pipeline small, then rotate the hook and record the journal.

Keep the small ledger small, then stage the queue and record the pipeline. When the ledger looks wrong, measure the stable token instead of the hook.

When the journal looks wrong, validate the warm token instead of the token. The small matcher only matters if the cache can wire the worker on its own.
